title: Roles, Ownership & Partner Engagement
body: Who owns each Blueprint step (AE, SE, BVC, partner), partner engagement models, RACI, and how partners accelerate and differentiate through Blueprint
kicker: 6 lessons · knowledge check at the end of this page
list_label: By the end of this module you can:
list: Assign AE, SE, BVC and partner ownership for each Blueprint step.
Select a partner engagement model for a deal.
Explain how partner-led discovery shortens the Blueprint cycle.
Describe when to request BVC support.
footnote: Recommended before this module: SBP-102. Prerequisites are proposed; roadmap mappings are alignment only, not equivalency.
